purpose: Freeze the page-facing Soldier detail data contract before Stage 5-2~5-7 generation. Reuse the validated Soldier pipeline and shared Hero-Soldier Relation Layer without re-deriving semantics in page code.

canonicalKey.rule: Every detail record represents exactly one canonical Soldier Master record. Names, siteId, tier, army type and numeric ID patterns are never JOIN keys.

topLevelShape.records: one detail record per canonical displayable soldier
topLevelShape.bySoldierId: optional lookup index: soldierId string -> record position or record reference

identity.normalSoldierId: explicit normal form ID or null
identity.spSoldierId: explicit SP form ID or null

combat.isMelee: auxiliary combat flag; never replaces range
combat.moveType: raw/normalized move-type source value preserved for later UI mapping

ability.techId: primary Lv1-10 TrainingTech ID for a normal tier-3 source, otherwise null
ability.levels: ordered Lv1-10 ability records when a validated primary path exists, otherwise empty
ability.finalDescription: Lv10 description derived from levels when present, otherwise null

training.techId: same validated primary TrainingTech ID as ability.techId
training.perLevelCost: ordered original Lv1-10 gold/material cost records; never discard source per-level values
training.lv5Total: derived cumulative cost through Lv5 or null
training.lv10Total: derived cumulative cost through Lv10 or null

heroes.finalHeroIds: canonical final usable-Hero membership copied only from hero-soldier-by-soldier.v1.json bySoldierId

recordShape.sp: null for normal Soldier records; SP detail object for SP Soldier records

abilityLevelShape.description: normal Soldier description for this level
abilityLevelShape.soldierSkillLevel: source SoldierSkillLevelup value preserved for validation

trainingCostShape.materials: original per-level material list without cumulative rewriting

spShape.spSoldierId: explicit SPSoldierInfo.ID and equal to the current record soldierId
spShape.statDelta: derived comparison of normal full SoldierInfo stats versus SP full SoldierInfo stats; display convenience only
spShape.descriptionLevels: ordered SP descriptions read from the validated normal-form primary TrainingTech level path
spShape.finalDescription: final SP description derived from descriptionLevels when present

stage1.missions: decoded first-stage MissionInfo records from the validated Stage3 pipeline

spShape.stage2: null when secondStageUnlock=false; otherwise contains awakenLevelId, awakenMaterials, decoded missions and expandHeroIds
spShape.expandedHeroIds: SecondStageExpandHeroList only; this is not the final usable-Hero list

conditionalRules: Every canonical displayable Soldier must receive exactly one detail record.
Normal and SP forms remain separate records and are linked only by the explicit SPSoldierInfo relationship.
For normal tier-3 Soldiers, ability/training must use the unique validated TrainingTech path whose SoldierSkillLevelup sequence is 1..10.
For tier-1/tier-2 or any record without a validated primary ten-level path, ability.levels and training.perLevelCost remain empty and cumulative totals remain null; do not invent a path.
For SP Soldiers, combat values come from the SP SoldierInfo full record, not normal values plus statDelta.
SP statDelta is derived only for comparison display and never becomes the canonical SP stat source.

SP description text must come from the validated SpSoidlierDescription/spDescription source on the normal-form primary TrainingTech path; do not rewrite the normal description by substituting numbers.
stage2 must be null when secondStageUnlock=false. Do not synthesize second-stage content for the 1-stage SP cases.
expandedHeroIds is SP second-stage provenance data only and must not be presented as the complete usable-Hero set.
heroes.finalHeroIds must be copied from validated bySoldierId membership and must never be recomputed from GetSoldierHeros_ID, SPHeroInfo rewards or SPSoldierInfo expansion fields inside Stage 5.
Do not synthesize Korean names for null/unreleased nameKr values; preserve nameKrStatus and validationStatus.
Release order and same-patch ordering are outside the 5-1 detail contract and belong to Stage 5-8 release metadata.

ownership.combatTrainingSpSource: data/generated/soldier-stage3.v1.json plus its validated Stage4 direct-JSON pipeline
ownership.pageBuilder: May normalize and derive page-display fields only; it must not reinterpret canonical JOIN semantics.

forbidden: Infer SP IDs using +5000 or any numeric offset
Use Soldier ID order as release order
Use GetSoldierTechId as the sole TrainingTech lookup rule
Use IsMelee as the source of attack range
Replace SP full stats with normal stats plus delta
Treat SecondStageExpandHeroList as final Hero membership
Recalculate Hero-Soldier membership in Soldier page code
Discard per-level training cost data after computing Lv5/Lv10 totals

stageOutputs.5-2: populate combat from the validated SoldierInfo-derived Stage3 record
stageOutputs.5-3: populate normal tier-3 ability Lv1-10 and SP descriptionLevels from the validated primary TrainingTech path
stageOutputs.5-4: populate original per-level training costs and derived Lv5/Lv10 cumulative totals
stageOutputs.5-5: attach heroes.finalHeroIds from the shared bySoldier index
stageOutputs.5-6: populate SP stage/mission/comparison detail for 56 SP records
stageOutputs.5-7: derive the list bundle from the same canonical identity rather than creating a second master
stageOutputs.5-8: attach release/order metadata separately without changing this identity/detail contract

completion: Stage 5-1 is complete when the Soldier detail record shape, source ownership, conditional nullability, shared relation consumption rule, SP full-record rule and later 5-2~5-8 boundaries are frozen so subsequent builders can populate data without reopening semantic/JOIN research.
